title: 🇵🇹 Clo Social Porto
description:
Revive os melhores momentos do nosso CLO Social Porto - o nosso primerio evento de networking em Portugal! Queremos deixar um sincero agradecimiento à nossa comunidade de utilizadores e às novas caras em Portugal. Que vieram partilhar as suas experiências com o CLO e a sua jornada de transformação 3D. Um grande obrigado a todos os que estiveram presentes!

------

Enjoy the highlights from our CLO Social Porto – our first-ever networking event in Portugal! We extend a heartfelt thank you to our existing user base and new faces in Portugal who came to share their experiences with CLO and their 3D transformation journey. Thank you to everyone who attended!

Sign up for our newsletter to stay up-to-date on more events across Europe, news, and updates! 👉 http://eepurl.com/hLgyyz 

Questions? Join our CLO Community on CONNECT 👉 https://connect.clo-set.com/community
transcript: Hello everyone and welcome to the first CLOU event in Portugal. The first event that we do in Porto, but it will not be the last. The idea is to create an innovation in the text area. The big advantage and the beauty of 3D are the data. The aim was essentially to fit photos and post prints. 5 million. Localization of cards, of cassettes, adapting several options. At the end of the day, digital will allow us to prototype to reduce risks and accelerate results. And that's it. That's how we pass from vision to reality. Thank you very much.
markdown_content: ## Introduction to CLOU Event in Porto This section introduces the first CLOU event held in Porto, Portugal, focusing on innovation in the textile industry through 3D technology and digital transformation. The inaugural CLOU event in Portugal took place in Porto, marking the beginning of a series of innovation-focused gatherings. The event emphasized advancing textile technology by leveraging 3D data. The core advantage of 3D in this context is its rich data capability, enabling detailed visualization and manipulation. The goal was to integrate photographic techniques and post-print processes, managing up to five million units. This included precise localization of cards and cassettes and adapting multiple options to fit production needs. ## Digital Prototyping and Risk Reduction in Textile Innovation This section covers the role of digital prototyping in reducing risks and accelerating outcomes in textile production, highlighting the transition from conceptual vision to practical reality. Digital technology allows for rapid prototyping, which significantly decreases risks inherent in traditional textile manufacturing. By simulating designs and processes digitally, developers can refine concepts before physical production, saving time and resources. This digital approach accelerates results, making it possible to move efficiently from initial vision to market-ready products. The CLOU event showcased how these techniques enable better decision-making and innovation within the textile sector.
